authoritative_rule: Agents MUST refresh current main and repository evidence before selecting or claiming a slot. queue_anchor_main_sha is an audit anchor, not permission to work from a stale base. The current snapshot retains only actionable OPEN slots; completed/promoted slots remain auditable in Git history and must not be re-claimed or force-moved.

auto_assignment.selection_rule: Choose the highest-priority OPEN slot allowed for the agent role whose dependencies are satisfied and whose runtime/planning boundary remains valid on current main.
auto_assignment.claim_branch_rule: Use the exact claim_branch declared by the slot. Create that remote branch from the exact current main SHA without force. Successful remote ref creation claims the slot. If the branch already exists or ref creation is rejected, treat the slot as already claimed and immediately evaluate the next eligible slot.
auto_assignment.no_valid_slot_behavior: Make no repository changes and report NO_VALID_WORK_SLOT.
revalidation_before_work: Read AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CHECKPOINT.md and docs/ENGINEERING-EXECUTION-GOVERNANCE.md.
Read current main SHA and commits since the queue audit anchor.
Inspect relevant open and merged PRs/MRs and existing branches.
Verify the selected slot is not already complete, superseded, blocked or claimed.
Verify canonical ownership, dependency order and allowed write scope.
Only then create the deterministic claim branch.
revalidation_before_merge: Absorb latest main using the repository-approved non-destructive strategy.
Review the intended diff and Integration Requirements.
Require applicable exact-head CI on the final candidate head.
Never use stale CI or force overwrite as merge evidence.

SUPERVISOR.description: Exactly one user-designated Supervisor/Integrator coordinates shared writes, merge review, queue reconciliation and supervisor-only slots. This role is explicit because independent AI sessions do not have a reliable cross-session lease/heartbeat mechanism.
must_not: Merge a branch only because an agent says it is done.
Treat arrival order as merge order.
Allow dependency-blocked runtime work to start.

WORKER.description: Workers autonomously inspect current repository truth and claim the next eligible non-overlapping work slot using deterministic remote branch creation.
must_not: Modify shared/global truth unless the slot explicitly grants that write scope.
Create a different branch name when the deterministic claim branch is already occupied.
Start runtime work that the slot marks planning_only or dependency_blocked.

slots.title: Add Policy-authorized native wordpress.posts execution V1
slots.source: Issue #66 Gate C plus Query Implementation Contract V1 and QUERY-WORDPRESS-POSTS-COMPILER-V1 deferred execution tranche after promoted PRs #143 and #145
dependencies: Query typed AST and structural validation V1 promoted
Query native wordpress.posts compiler V1 promoted
shared Data Source authorization mapping V1 promoted
Query Policy-authorized planning V1 promoted via PR #143
canonical native wordpress.posts Data Source/module registration V1 promoted via PR #145
canonical shared Cache seam confirmed; cache behavior remains deferred in this tranche
GOV-OWNER-CONSENT-001 remains active for bounded Query runtime implementation
allowed_scope: Query-owned provider execution interface/service and immutable normalized execution result/error values
a testable native WordPress posts execution adapter may instantiate WP_Query only from an already-authorized QueryProviderPlan produced by QueryAuthorizedPlanner
top-level execution orchestration must call QueryAuthorizedPlanner before provider execution and must not accept a provider plan as an authorization substitute
support only provider wordpress.wp_query.posts and source wordpress.posts from the already-certified native compiler V1
normalize ID-only WP_Query results and bounded WP_Post-like results into projection-keyed rows without exposing raw WP_Query or SQL diagnostics
fail closed on provider/source mismatch, malformed provider rows, unsupported projection shapes, unavailable native WP_Query API or provider failure using the stable Query error taxonomy
wire Query-owned execution services through QueryModule while keeping Bootstrap/Plugin.php untouched
Query-local unit/static/architecture tests and bounded native-adapter tests
no raw SQL, wpdb, query-clause filters, arbitrary PHP/callbacks/eval, unchecked identifiers or arbitrary class/function names

no cache lookup/write/invalidation behavior, relation traversal execution, parameter binding, cursor semantics, aggregation/total-count, REST/AJAX/admin/CLI/workflow/AI exposure or Gate C completion claim
slots.completion_condition: A reviewable Query execution path proves QueryDefinition + ExecutionContext -> canonical QueryAuthorizedPlanner -> bounded wordpress.wp_query.posts executor -> immutable normalized result, with native provider failures normalized safely and no execution possible before canonical Policy authorization. The native adapter may use only public WP_Query arguments already emitted by the certified compiler. Exact-head applicable CI must pass before promotion.
slots.notes: This is the first actual native provider-execution slice. Shared cache integration, Relations execution, richer predicates, diagnostics, public/admin exposure, performance/reference evidence and full Query Gate C certification remain separate later tranches.
